title: Ammonium Benzoicum
text: This remedy is indicated in cases of urinary disorders, especially those related to the kidneys. It is useful in cases of dropsy and albuminuria. There is a general feeling of heaviness and soreness in the renal region. It is also useful in cases of gout and rheumatism. Headache, with a sensation of weight in the forehead. Vertigo. Appetite poor. Nausea. Burning in the stomach. Distended and tender. Rumbling. Scanty, dark, and foul-smelling urine. Albuminuria. Burning in the urethra. Stones in the kidneys. Compare: Benzoic acid; Berberis; Lycopodium. Third to sixth trituration.
